source_type_definitions.real_provider_request_capture: A request body FirstKnock actually sent to BatchData, recorded verbatim at the time it was sent.
source_type_definitions.provider_supplied_example: A payload BatchData themselves sent to FirstKnock as a recommended example.
source_type_definitions.provider_supplied_dataset: A data export BatchData themselves produced and delivered to FirstKnock.
source_type_definitions.observed_response_assertion: Specific cited facts recorded about a real response. The response body itself was not retained.
source_type_definitions.reconstructed_response: A response-shaped object assembled field-by-field from observed_response_assertion entries. NOT a raw capture and never citable as provider contract evidence on its own.
source_type_definitions.internal_research_document: FirstKnock-authored research describing the provider. Secondary corroboration only.
source_type_definitions.synthetic_failure_safety: Invented input used only to prove fail-closed behaviour. Never contract evidence.
